::: {#viewer-embed}
<iframe id="viewer-frame" title="OceanBench fields explorer" src="viewer/index.html?embed=1"></iframe>
:::

```{=html}
<style>
/* Full-bleed app page: the viewer fills the viewport exactly, minus the site
   navbar. No title block, no content margins, no page footer, no page scrollbar.
   Every rule is scoped to this page's body class so other pages are untouched. */
html:has(body.viewer-page),
body.viewer-page {
  height: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  overscroll-behavior: none;
}
body.viewer-page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
body.viewer-page #quarto-header { flex: 0 0 auto; }
body.viewer-page #quarto-content,
body.viewer-page main.content,
body.viewer-page .page-columns,
body.viewer-page #quarto-document-content {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: block;
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
}
body.viewer-page #quarto-content > * { grid-column: 1 / -1 !important; }
/* The article header (title block) and the site footer both belong to a document
   page, not to an app shell; neither has anything to say here and both would eat
   viewport height or create a scrollbar. */
body.viewer-page #title-block-header,
body.viewer-page header#title-block-header,
body.viewer-page .quarto-title-block,
body.viewer-page #quarto-margin-sidebar,
body.viewer-page .nav-footer,
body.viewer-page footer.footer,
body.viewer-page #quarto-footer,
body.viewer-page .quarto-title-banner { display: none !important; }
#viewer-embed {
  height: calc(100dvh - var(--viewer-chrome, 0px));
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
#viewer-frame {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: 0;
  resize: none;
}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  document.body.classList.add("viewer-page");
  var frame = document.getElementById("viewer-frame");

  // Size the app to the space left under the navbar. Measuring instead of assuming
  // keeps the fit exact when the navbar wraps or the theme changes its height.
  function chromeHeight() {
    var header = document.getElementById("quarto-header");
    return header ? header.getBoundingClientRect().height : 0;
  }
  function sizeApp() {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--viewer-chrome", chromeHeight() + "px");
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", sizeApp);
  if (window.ResizeObserver) {
    var header = document.getElementById("quarto-header");
    if (header) new ResizeObserver(sizeApp).observe(header);
  }
  sizeApp();

  // Theme: the site's toggle stamps quarto-dark / quarto-light on <body>; forward it.
  function currentTheme() {
    return document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark") ? "dark" : "light";
  }
  function sendTheme() {
    if (frame.contentWindow) frame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: "oceanbench-theme", theme: currentTheme() }, "*");
  }
  new MutationObserver(sendTheme).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
  window.addEventListener("message", function (event) {
    if (event.data && event.data.type === "oceanbench-viewer-ready") sendTheme();
  });

  // Deep links: seed the iframe from this page's hash, and mirror the app's hash back
  // so shared URLs (…/viewer.html#…) reproduce the exact view.
  var base = "viewer/index.html?embed=1&theme=" + currentTheme();
  frame.src = base + (location.hash || "#theme=" + currentTheme());
  frame.addEventListener("load", function () {
    sizeApp();
    sendTheme();
    try {
      frame.contentWindow.addEventListener("hashchange", function () {
        var h = frame.contentWindow.location.hash;
        if (h && h !== location.hash) history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.search + h);
      });
    } catch (e) { /* cross-origin (shouldn't happen, same host) */ }
  });
})();
</script>
```
